pairs.difference: A: the vinyl has thin raised weld seams along the panel edges and small, tight highlights on the red and blue panels. B: panel joins are plain colour edges with no seam ridge, the purple cap is a flat disc, and the white panel carries a broad milky glow. Both are under the real gloss range; B's highlight share is higher and its detail lower.
pairs.fix: Thin raised weld seams along every panel edge, a small tight highlight on the vinyl, and a slightly raised valve cap with a fine rim.

pairs.difference: A: the bear reads as felt with small sewn seams, and the easel has a small brass bolt. The target face is quiet matte paint. B: the bear's face and belly are smooth like vinyl with only a faint fuzz, the frame posts carry large decorative grain, and the target's white rim is hot (highlight share 0.231, at the top of the real range).
pairs.fix: Soft felt plush bear with fine sewn seams, fine quiet wood grain on the frame, and a matte painted target with no hot white rim.

pairs.difference: A: the white casing has a soft sheen band, and the satin metal trim strip and house badge read as a second material. B: the whole unit is one lavender satin plastic, including the badge, with no change of gloss across seams or vents (gloss 0.033 against 0.124). A does carry faint speckle on the casing.
pairs.fix: White casing with one soft sheen band, plus a brushed metal trim strip and a metal badge that catch light differently from the plastic.

pairs.difference: B: crisp faceted gems, ball rivets on every corner, hard-edged plank lines and busy gold coin stacks; the detail is sharp everywhere and pushed up. A: soft coins, quiet fine wood lines and plain gold bands, closer to the restrained real finish, though its gold leans towards yellow plastic.
pairs.fix: Fewer rivets, fine quiet wood grain on the planks, and softer coin edges with one small highlight each.

pairs.difference: B: the navy brim has a muddy smeared reflection and the floor carries big dark decorative grain lines. A: matte cloth on the crown with a soft edge seam, a separate satin brim and quiet floor grain, though the rope ring is crisp. Measured numbers are almost equal, so this rests on the brim and floor marks.
pairs.fix: Clean single soft highlight on the lacquered brim, matte white cloth on the crown, and fine quiet floorboard grain.

pairs.difference: B: the box is one flat saturated red with almost no sheen change, and the window bars on the left side wobble and smear. A: painted red with soft sheen, steel hinges, a gold handle and glass with a clean diagonal reflection, so three materials read separately.
pairs.fix: Painted cast-iron red with a soft sheen along the edges, straight clean window bars, and glass with one thin diagonal reflection.

pairs.difference: A: the leather has fine puckers around the thumb, a soft broken sheen, and a strap with fine woven texture. B: the gloves are smooth balloons with a few drawn crease lines and a wide airbrushed glow; no leather surface shows (detail 0.0118 and gloss 0.015, both under the real range).
pairs.fix: Red leather with small puckered wrinkles at the thumb and cuff, a narrow soft sheen, and a matte woven strap.

pairs.difference: A: matte charcoal rubber on the foot pocket against glossy yellow blades with a bright sharp rim, so gloss varies within the object. B: blades, pocket and insert share one even satin finish, with the blade border only a colour gradient (gloss 0.018 against 0.059).
pairs.fix: Matte dark rubber foot pocket against glossy moulded yellow blades, with a thin sharp highlight along the blade rails.

pairs.difference: B: post tops have big carved cracks, the rope is enlarged into chunky toy coils, and the ring wrap is a thick band. A: boards carry quiet fine grain, small dull metal nail heads and thin rope at a believable scale.
pairs.fix: Fine quiet wood grain on posts, thin rope with small twists, and small dull metal nail heads on the boards.

pairs.difference: B: the trunk has large carved cracks and hard ring joints, the fronds have crisp drawn midribs, and the rocks are hard-edged. A: the trunk is smooth with soft rings and only a few pits on the coconuts, a quiet finish closer to the real cards, though its gloss of 0.03 sits just under the real range.
pairs.fix: Smooth trunk with soft rings and only faint fine fibres, and fronds with soft shading in place of hard drawn ribs.

pairs.difference: A: the locker and its pill-shaped vents are one thick glossy plastic, and the keyhole plate is a chunky toy piece, so nothing reads as painted steel. B: metal hinges, a metal handle, cloth-bound book covers and a pebbled matte basketball give a clearer material range. Numbers do not separate them.
pairs.fix: Painted steel locker with thin stamped vents, small metal hinges and latch, and a matte pebbled basketball.

pairs.difference: B: the slide is flat matte green with blotchy shadow patches and no wet sheen, and the platform underside shows large wood grain (gloss 0.033). A: glossy gel-coat green with thin clean highlights along the rims, and clear polished steel-blue posts.
pairs.fix: Glossy fibreglass slide with long thin highlights along the rims, and smooth wet-looking inner channels.

pairs.difference: B: the body is an inflated, airbrushed lump with almost no gloss (0.011, the bottom of the range), no seams, a plain button disc, and highlights over range (0.179). Only the earbud mesh grilles show fine detail. A: matte rubbery body with a thin inset panel line and glossy LEDs and earbuds, so the gloss range is clear.
pairs.fix: Thin inset panel line around the face, matte soft-touch body, and small glossy LEDs and buttons that contrast with it.

pairs.difference: B: the envelope is a puffy, thick-rimmed moulded shape, like plastic or fondant, and the photo inside is painted with dense small detail (foliage, arches, ripples) that outruns the object. A: paper has flat folds and thin creases, and the photo is simplified with big shapes, though A's own numbers run slightly over the real range.
pairs.fix: Thin matte paper envelope with sharp flat folds and fine crease lines, and a simple photo made of large flat shapes.

pairs.difference: B: watermelon seeds are enlarged and lacquered, the grapes are smooth wax-like balls, droplets are scattered widely including on the plate, and the table grain is large. A: watermelon flesh has fine pulp speckle, droplets are few, and the table grain is fine. The pair is close.
pairs.fix: Fine pulpy flesh, small matte seeds, only a few droplets, and fine quiet table grain.

pairs.difference: A: the blue door is covered in streaky painterly grain and blotchy noise, and the frame and ivy add dense marks everywhere; detail, micro-texture and gloss (0.0884, 0.0447, 0.51) are all far above the real range. B: door paint is calmer, with a clean brass knob and readable satin ribbon, and its numbers are close to the real range.
pairs.fix: Smooth satin painted door with only faint fine grain, no streaks or blotches, and quiet shading in the panels.

pattern: Generated cards still give themselves away by surface finish that is not controlled the way the real cards' is. They tend to fall one of two ways: one even airbrushed, inflated material with no change of gloss within the object (boxing gloves, music player, fins, slide), or detail pushed up and enlarged into decoration, such as carved cracks in wood, chunky rope, rivets everywhere, lacquered seeds, painterly streaks and dense small scenes (pier, chest, palm trunk, door, envelope photo). Real cards keep matte and shiny parts separate on one object, hold grain fine and quiet, and put small crisp detail only where the material needs it.
